items.text: I push myself to hit ambitious goals, even when no one is checking
I adjust easily when plans change at the last minute
I catch small errors that others tend to miss
I slow down to weigh risks before committing to a decision
I go out of my way to make teamwork smooth for everyone involved
People know they can count on me to follow through
I notice and respond to how others are feeling
I'm quick to credit others and admit when I'm wrong
I start things on my own without being asked
I look for new or unconventional ways to solve a problem
I stick to what's right even when it's inconvenient
I dig into a topic just because I want to understand it better
I naturally step up to guide a group toward a goal
I expect things to work out, even when the path isn't clear
I keep going on something hard long after it stops being fun
I trust my own judgment, even under pushback
I stay composed when things get tense or frustrating
I say what I actually mean, even in small talk
I'd rather work closely with people than work alone all day
I stay effective when deadlines and pressure pile up
I'm comfortable moving forward without a fully clear plan
